verdict.rationale: Gitea ships its own CI/CD engine (Gitea Actions) and an official action runner that users deploy themselves, and its commercial offering lists Kubernetes AutoScaling Runners, so running pipelines on private runners is supported. Nothing in the evidence shows platform-hosted runners (the managed offering describes a managed Gitea environment, not hosted runners) or a centralized view of runners and pipeline runs. Missing for 10: documented platform-hosted runners, centralized visibility or management of runners and runs, depth on runner registration and scoping, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run pipelines on platform-hosted runners or my own private runners with centralized visibility

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions.
We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
